source: Actual shared Windows laptop, Linux Docker render peers. Control/status response samples, not render speed or SLA. Active-render direct-loopback probe: 10 sequential requests with 300ms spacing; held-peer probe: 12 localhost requests with 500ms spacing, spa temporarily paused and always restored. Localhost address resolution/connection overhead is included; probes are not directly equivalent.
